Material Info This is with reference to our letter dated July 30 2026 regarding implementation of the Honble Lahore High Court sanctioned Capital Reduction, consequential Stock Split, alteration of Authorized Share Capital and operational processing thereof by Central Depository Company of Pakistan Limited, National Clearing Company of Pakistan Limited and Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited.

Material Info Further to our earlier correspondence regarding implementation of the capital restructuring of WorldCall Telecom Limited sanctioned by the Honorable Lahore High Court, Lahore vide Order dated July 08, 2026 passed in C.O. No. 31942 of 2026, we are pleased to inform you that the operational procedures relating to the Capital Reduction and consequential Stock Split have been completed.

Material Info This is with reference to the corporate actions of the Company relating to the reduction of share capital, as sanctioned by the Honorable High Court, and the share split in the ratio of one (1) existing ordinary share into ten (10) ordinary shares, details of which have already been disseminated to the Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited dated July 31, 2026.

Material Info In continuation of our earlier Material Information Revised dated July 28 2026 please be informed that the revised Book Closure dates have been withdrawn. The new Book Closure dates are August 08 2026 to August 09 2026 both days inclusive.

Material Info Kindly refer to the Material Information disseminated by the Company through PUCARS on July 28, 2026 regarding the revised implementation schedule of the Court-sanctioned capital restructuring.

In this regard, we enclose herewith the newspaper clippings to the Public Notice published on July 29, 2026 in the following nationwide newspapers:
- Daily Express (Urdu)
- The Express Tribune (English)

Material Info we are pleased to inform you that the Honble Lahore High Court, Lahore, vide Order No. 31942 of 2026 dated July 08, 2026, has sanctioned the reduction of the paid-up ordinary share capital of WorldCall Telecom Limited under Sections 89 to 93 of the Companies Act, 2017.

Material Info we are pleased to inform you that the Honble Lahore High Court, Lahore, vide Order No. 31942 of 2026 dated July 08, 2026, has sanctioned the reduction of the paid-up ordinary share capital of WorldCall Telecom Limited under Sections 89 to 93 of the Companies Act, 2017.

Material Info In accordance with Section 96 of the Securities Act 2015 and Clause 5.6.1 of the Rule Book of the Exchange, we are pleased to inform you that the Honerable Lahore High Court, Lahore, vide Order No. 31942 of 2026 dated July 08, 2026, has sanctioned the reduction of the paid-up ordinary share capital of WorldCall Telecom Limited under Sections 89 to 93 of the Companies Act 2017.

Material Info In accordance with Section 96 of the Securities Act 2015 and Clause 5.6.1 of the Rule Book of the Exchange, we are pleased to inform you that the Honerable Lahore High Court, Lahore, vide Order No. 31942 of 2026 dated July 08, 2026, has sanctioned the reduction of the paid-up ordinary share capital of WorldCall Telecom Limited under Sections 89 to 93 of the Companies Act 2017.

Material Info In accordance with Section 96 and 131 of the Securities Act, 2015 and Clause 5.6.1(a)(xii) of the Rule Book of the Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited, we hereby convey the following:

Pursuant to the provision of section 187 of the Act, Mr. Abbas Raza has been re-appointed as Chief Executive Officer of the Company for a term of three year commencing from 31 May 2026 on the same terms and conditions.

You may inform the TRE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly.

Material Info WTL hereby informs that an Emergent Meeting of its Board of Directors was held on April 8, 2026, at 04:00 p.m. at its Head Office, Lahore. The Board approved and recommended the following, subject to regulatory and shareholders approvals at the upcoming AGM 1. Change of Name: From WorldCall Telecom Limited to WorldCall Technologies Limited. 2. Global Expansion: Acquisition of a wholly owned subsidiary in the UAE for international operations. and Share Swap: Proposed swap of shares with GlobalTech Corporation (ultimate holding company). 3. Balance Sheet Restructuring: Under Section 89(a) of the Companies Act, 2017 for adjustment of discount on issued shares and accumulated losses. and CPS Extension of mandatory conversion date of Convertible Preference Shares till December 31, 2030 4. Appointments: External auditors and election scrutinizer approved.
5. Authorization: CEO CFO Company Secretary and or any Director authorized to complete all regulatory n statutory formalities
